{{recipe}}

'''Nigerian tea''' refers to a hot chocolate beverage usually served at breakfast and with bread, meat pie, and many other snacks. Despite the name, there is no actual [[Cookbook:Tea|tea]] in the beverage.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-01-30 |title=A Definitive Ranking of Cocoa Beverages-Roll Call |url=https://www.eatdrinklagos.com/roll-call/2020/1/30/a-definitive-ranking-of-cocoa-beverages |access-date=2023-06-24 |website=Eat.Drink.Lagos |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Nigerian Tea |url=https://www.allnigerianrecipes.com/breakfast-recipes/nigerian-tea/ |access-date=2023-06-24 |website=All Nigerian Recipes |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Evaporated milk|Evaporated milk]] (preferably Peak Milk brand)
*Milo chocolate drink mix
*Hot [[Cookbook:Water|water]]

==Procedure==
#Pour the evaporated milk into a mug, and stir in the chocolate drink mix.
#Stir in hot water.
#Serve with bread, Nigerian meat pie, or other Nigerian snacks.
